about: The coding agents this kit can register its MCP server with, as rows of data. A new agent costs a row. Read by lib/agents.mjs; checked by tests/agents.test.mjs. Placeholders in an argument list: {name} the server's name, {scope} the chosen scope, {command} the program that starts the server (an absolute path to this Node), and {...args} (a whole element) which expands to the server's arguments. We never edit an agent's own configuration file: registration is the agent's own command, and reading is the agent's own list or get command. Nothing here reads, copies or stores a credential, a login or a token.

files.note: The user-level file is kept by `claude mcp`; this kit never reads or writes it.

mcp.restartHint: Start a new Claude Code session in your game folder (or run /mcp inside one) so it picks up the new server.

files.note: Codex keeps its servers in the user-level file; this kit adds one only through `codex mcp add`.

mcp.restartHint: Start a new Codex session so it picks up the new server.
